## Problem and change

Explain the concrete problem and final behavior. Link the task: Closes #N for full completion, or Refs #N for partial work.

## Prerequisite evidence

List every Blocked by issue, its CLOSED state, and merged PR/commit. For a declared independent task, explain why it has no prerequisites.

- [ ] Every prerequisite was CLOSED before implementation started; its deliverable was available on main.
- [ ] Prerequisites remain CLOSED and this PR targets main.

## Verification

Record exact commands and observed outcomes, including relevant invalid/failure cases. State checks not run and why. Link configurations, traces/results or an accessible manifest as appropriate.

## Limitations

State remaining uncertainty or work outside this task. Do not claim planned experiments as completed results.

## AI assistance and human verification

Describe tools used and what they helped with. Name actual human checks; do not prefill another person's approval.

- [ ] Owner inspected the complete diff and the reported evidence.
- [ ] A different teammate is designated to verify the latest commit before merge.

The reviewer records the checked commit, commands and results in their review. Agent self-review does not replace teammate review. Follow [the collaboration guide](https://github.com/qikhcysa/dase7508-agent-privacy-boundaries/blob/main/docs/COLLABORATION.md).
